Title: LSJ: Ian Forestal and Camarilla Vitae Slave

Messages.Author: Simon Klibisch
Messages.Body:
Hi!
Is Ian Forestal able to benefit from Camarilla Vitae Slave (in case he
became by some means Lasombra)?

Simon

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
"Simon Klibisch" <Simon.K...@t-online.de> wrote in message
news:9tm6pu$c3l$04$1...@news.t-online.com...

> Is Ian Forestal able to benefit from Camarilla Vitae Slave (in case he
> became by some means Lasombra)?

Yes and No.

If he gains another discipline, via a discipline master card,
then Camarilla Vitae Slave will allow him to play cards at the
superior.

However, putting the discipline card on him already grants him
the superior of that discipline so it is pretty pointless to
waste the actions to become Lasombra and to gain the Camarilla
Vitae Slave.

The only disciplines Ian Forestal has, he already has at superior.
Auspex, Dominate, Thaumaturgy -- he does not have any other disciplines.

Carpe noctem.

Lasombra

The Lasombra wrote:
> "Simon Klibisch" <Simon.K...@t-online.de> wrote in message

> > Is Ian Forestal able to benefit from Camarilla Vitae Slave (in case he
> > became by some means Lasombra)?
>
> Yes and No.
>
> If he gains another discipline, via a discipline master card,
> then Camarilla Vitae Slave will allow him to play cards at the
> superior.
>
> However, putting the discipline card on him already grants him
> the superior of that discipline so it is pretty pointless to
> waste the actions to become Lasombra and to gain the Camarilla
> Vitae Slave.
>
> The only disciplines Ian Forestal has, he already has at superior.
> Auspex, Dominate, Thaumaturgy -- he does not have any other disciplines.

Correct. The only way Ian could benefit from the Vitae Slave is
if his special ability was turned off (e.g., Seeds of Corruption), or if
some non-"Master: Disipline" effect granted him a discipline (e.g., Vial
of Elder Vitae).
